lessons.key: surviving_mutant::prove a ci log grep against a real log from the current toolchain e g xcode 26 logs retries as started iteration 2 of 2 never against strings copied from an older pipeline
lessons.text: Prove a CI log-grep against a real log from the current toolchain (e.g. Xcode 26+ logs retries as 'started (Iteration 2 of 2)'), never against strings copied from an older pipeline.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::guard scripts must fail on missing inputs and distinguish grep exit 1 no match from exit 2 error and be tested on the ci s own os gnu vs bsd
lessons.text: Guard scripts must fail on missing inputs and distinguish grep exit 1 (no match) from exit 2 (error), and be tested on the CI's own OS (GNU vs BSD).

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec says warnings as errors in ci name the job that enforces it and pass the treat warnings as errors flags there explicitly
lessons.text: When a spec says 'warnings as errors in CI', name the job that enforces it and pass the treat-warnings-as-errors flags there explicitly.
